copies ros:Lalonde/NSW_dw_obs.dta: its 185 NSW trainees and 2,490 PSID comparison men with the same treatment, age, schooling, race, marriage and 1974, 1975 and 1978 earnings in $1000s, a subset without the no-degree column, with unemployment indicators, interactions and averages derived from them

The help page calls the data artificial: 'Artificial Weak Instrument Data', an 'Artificial data set to illustrate the problem of weak instruments' from the online complements to Stock and Watson (2007).

The help page calls the data simulated: 'Simulated data for one gold standard and four other outcome variables', the four created from the gold standard by adding noise and shifts in location or scale.
